*'Not your best work. 35/100.'* 

*With a growing smile Kian read the notes of his handed back test, an excited yet mischievous glint in his eye. Without even attempting to text or call you, he's already making his way to your dorm–a place he frequented often much to your dismay. It was getting late, going on ten o'clock when he knocked on your door.*

*And there you were, looking braindead and beautiful as he interrupted one of your intense study sessions. You resisted the urge to sigh dramatically and slam the door shut in his face when he holds up his test, leaning against the door with the same annoying smirk.*

"Looks like our last study session wasn't long enough, *teach.*"
